GainsBlock.rationale: `public override bool GainsBlock => true` (Finesse.cs:13) == the class attribute.

ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (Finesse.cs:21-24) == cost 0 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new BlockVar(4m, ValueProp.Move)` + `new CardsVar(1)` (Finesse.cs:15-19) == both numbers, both declared. Move without Unpowered -> POWERED block, so NOT in gap G1's blast radius.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: `CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Block, cardPlay)` FIRST (Finesse.cs:33) == `BlockCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._block, card=self)`, then `CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, DynamicVars.Cards.BaseValue, Owner)` (34) == `DrawCmd.draw(ctx.player, self._cards)`.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Block.UpgradeValueBy(3m)` (Finesse.cs:28) == `self._block += 3` (4 -> 7). The CARDS var stays 1 when upgraded on both sides. Note C# declares OnUpgrade BEFORE OnPlay in this file, which is the only card in the batch to do so -- no behavioural consequence, but worth stating so the read order is not mistaken for a missing override.
